# togetherai_hardware (Data Source)

Hardware instance types for dedicated inference deployments, with on-demand prices and regions (`GET /v2/public/inference-instance-types`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "togetherai_hardware" "all" {}

# Hourly price of one replica, in dollars, per hardware type.
output "hourly_price" {
  value = { for h in data.togetherai_hardware.all.hardware : h.id => h.price_cents_per_hour / 100 }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `hardware` (Attributes List) Instance types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hardware))

<a id="nestedatt--hardware"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hardware`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description.
- `gpu_count` (Number) GPUs per replica.
- `gpu_memory_gib` (Number) Memory per GPU in GiB.
- `gpu_type` (String) GPU model, such as `H100`.
- `id` (String) Instance type ID, such as `1xnvidia-h100-80gb`.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `price_cents_per_hour` (Number) On-demand price of one replica in US cents per hour.
- `regions` (List of String) Regions where it is offered.
